newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds closed unchanged and tradeless.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds closed unchanged and tradeless.

text.p: UK meals and feeds closed tradeless, with selling levels unmoved from Thursday's finish due to a lack of directional input overnight.
However, early indications from the Chicago soybean meal futures on Friday are that prices are easing, so prices in the UK may dip after the holiday on Monday.
"There's no demand for material presently and with the UK closed on Monday, we'll have to wait and see what Chicago does over the next couple of trading days," one trader said.
